# jde.ap.voucher.search

Find AP vouchers

**Purpose:** Search AP vouchers by supplier, GL date, pay status or document type.

- App / module / entity / verb: `jde` / `ap` / `voucher` / `search`
- Archetype: `transactional`
- Sensitivity: `financial`
- Write: `false`
- Binding type: `function` (`JDE AIS Orchestration`, ref `AP_Voucher_Search` v1.0)
- Identity carries: `unverified`
- Core tool for roles: `p2p`

## Disambiguation

Finds vouchers by supplier, date or amount when you do not know the document number. To read one known voucher use jde.ap.voucher.get; to create one use jde.ap.voucher.create; to void one use jde.ap.voucher.cancel.

## Aliases

- find vouchers
- supplier invoice search
- AP voucher lookup

| Name | Type | Required | Description | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `supplier_number` | string | yes | JDE address book number of the supplier. | — |
| `company` | string | no | JDE company code. | — |
| `pay_status` | string | no | Payment status code to filter by. | — |
| `document_type` | string | no | Voucher document type code. | — |
| `gl_date_from` | string | no | Earliest GL date, YYYY-MM-DD. | format date |
| `gl_date_to` | string | no | Latest GL date, YYYY-MM-DD. | format date |
